reviews.x: I bought both this soft brush and the blue medium brush. I had previously been using the Palm Annie brushes faithfully. I realized that I could not get my crown to where I wanted it to be with those brushes. I had already been well informed on wave products since I’ve been a consumer of the YouTube wave community since soul seeka was top dog. After seeing the endorsements by some of my most frequently visited wave channels, I decided to give these brushes a try. Needless to say, I’ve only been u

I’ve been a waver for some time now using wave enforcer brushes, original diane brushes, crown brushes exc. but these torino pros are awesome. my wave depth has improved after using for a week. the soft brushes bristles do a fantastic job laying your frizz down. a must need brush after a 1.5 cut and great finisher brush after a good brush session. the curve is good for maintaining your connections and the pointed tip is great for working in and around your crown area. what impresses me the most

I actually tried to not like this brush. Being an OG waver since early 2000’s, I was stuck in my ways thinking ANY decent brush was good enough for your waves. Maaannnnnn listen, I’m glad my girl put me on to these. Quality is fire, the curve makes it easy to hit all my angles, the brush is super soft but it’s still strong enough to get down in your new growth even if you’re wolfing. The tip makes it easy to get my crown together too. I noticed a difference in my waves in just two days of use, n

reviews.t: Want a quality brush? Just get a brush from Brush King and You will be happy with it!
reviews.x: As a coarse hair waver is difficult to find a brush with noticeable pull but the Torino Pro line is a excellent choice. My orders arrived on time and in great condition. This one came with a very small chip probably from shipping but it’s nothing major or anything to complain about. I love these brushes. Keep producing quality products Brush King and you will have a repeat customer in me.

i purchased all 3 Torino brushes.  hard (red), medium (blue), soft (teal).  within 2 days  of receiving the brushes, the soft brush cracked down the back and small stress cracks formed along the bristle holes.  I am very disappointed and perplexed.  I cannot explain why this happened to a brand new brush.

This is a medium soft brush. When I first recieved it I found it difficult to distinguish between this and my medium Torino Pro. For the medium version I  wrote a review even though I purchased it direct. Comparing them side to side for firmness of the bristles was a bit eye opening for me. Perhaps I just can’t personally distinguish but, it’s still a good brush. It’s just doesn’t seem as soft as I had imagined it would be.

reviews.t: My soldier loves it, so I love it!!
reviews.x: My soldier loves the brush... He's getting waves!!!

reviews.t: You Need This In Your Rotation!!
reviews.x: For my semi coarse wavers... this is a must buy! When you’re wrapping up your brush session and it’s time to wrap up this gives you the perfect pull and lay down power to polish your waves and lock them juices and berries in. Also, if you keep this brush on you throughout the day for touch up purposes it’s perfect for that as well. Plus the ladies digg the color.

The bristles to this brush were ok but I will not buy this again. I bought three of these brushes the hard, medium and soft. On all the of them the paint chipped on the brush a lot! These are just about the most expensive wave brushes on the market so I expected more. The company should be ashamed. It chipped after only 4 months.

reviews.t: Good brush just a few issues.
reviews.x: I loved the brush in the beginning but the bristles began to fall out pretty quickly following consistent use. I also noticed that some bristles were uneven which sometimes caused pain when brushing. Other than that this brush isn’t too bad.

Great coverage, perfect curve, great bristle quality. I swear by Brush King! It’s really fully of bristles so it feels closer to a medium but definitely a soft brush. A little big for a travel brush but it’s a must have!

This brush is not as good as my 5 dollar Diane brush.  It sheds like crazy and the bristles are way too long.  This is a woman’s brush for long hair not for 360 waves.  I was fooled by all of these 5 star comments.
My son bought this brush. He likes it. It works for his waves. Just a little softer then he realized but still good.
Too soft! Good for straight haired dudes. I got thick, curly hair so a bad choice.

reviews.t: Bristles fall out so much in the beginning!!!!
reviews.x: Great overall brush Nice wide head. Long bristles Waves transform into the ocean

Really good size brush that makes brushing a lot easier and covers more ground with each brush session.  The bristles are soft and the curvature with the base help ensure every part of your hair touched. To add to it, the paint finish is really nice which makes it stand out from other brands.  I’ll definitely be getting another Torino brush!

The product was purchased for my mother who has a mild form of Alopecia. She uses it daily and it helps to stop the breakage that she has. Wonderful amazing brush. I used it twice for my 360 waves and it laid all of the frizzy hair down in a snap with minimal effort. HIGHLY RECOMMEND this product!!!!!!!!

Feels great brushing my short hair. My barber @_hairmes put me onto this and I’m glad he did. My only small doubt was that I was expecting a teal brush with wood grain/marbling and what I received was just a plain teal brush. Not a deal breaker but pictures should match the product.

Good brush, the long handle gets in the way some times, nice for laying down the waves worth the brush, once you get through the first week of little bristles falling out of the brush into your hair! Overall solid pretty blue finish on the brush.

I’m satisfied with my purchase. I definitely will be buying again! I’m using the medium brush right now and it’s giving me absolute results with helping my hair lay down. Once I get a cut I’ll transition into the soft bristle.

I’m so wavy with this brush. When I’m in between them thighs she’s not the only thing that’s wet, and that’s off tops 🤷🏽‍♂️ I got this brush because the God Brush (Torino 350) was sold out but this still got the job done ✅

Nice soft brush. Excellent feel for finishing those long brush sessions like brushing with a pillow. The pointed end on these brushes is great for precision crown work. My 360 w/ swirl is coming in nicely

Awesome brush. Very high quality and worth the price. This one is soft!!! It is necessary for getting your waves right. Brush king is great. I've ordered six brushes from them and never had any issues
I like it it a lot of money one then I hate is that the brush stuff get on my hair and I have to brush it of with my hand but is still good The more you trained the more waves you get 💡

reviews.t: The best brushes I ever owned
reviews.x: Torino never fails I am a consistent buyer of them and my collection is getting bigger I would love to receive a bulk to do a review on my YouTube Channel one day when I get my rank up

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the brush's quality and effectiveness for waves, saying it improves wave depth and lays frizz down.
Several reviewers report durability problems, including bristles falling out and the brush cracking shortly after purchase.
Some reviewers complain about paint chipping off the brush.
A few reviewers find the soft brush too soft, especially for thicker or coarser hair.
Reviewers note the brush's curved shape and wide head make it easy to hit angles and provide good coverage.
